comment: Single source of truth for the 8-slot legoarch prompt grammar. Backend: prompt_enhance.py derives STYLE_SUFFIX and the enhancer reference (', '.join of slot examples) from this file. Frontend: synced to frontend/src/lib/promptGrammar.gen.json by scripts/sync_grammar.mjs — edit HERE, then run the sync. The sync asserts the join-invariant.

trigger.ui_hint: The trigger word — added server-side, it activates the custom LoRA fine-tuned on 40 official-style set photos.

style_suffix: standalone model on dark display base, white background, elevated 3/4 angle, product photography, studio lighting, official LEGO set photography

slots.name: Identity
slots.description: Building + city + architect — the proper nouns that anchor the subject.
slots.ui_hint: Who and where. Proper nouns anchor the form the image model reaches for.

slots.name: LEGO set framing
slots.description: Declares the subject as a LEGO Architecture set, not a real building.
slots.ui_hint: Frames the render as a set photo — scale, studs and plastic follow from these four words.

slots.name: Massing
slots.description: Fused massing with verbs, described as one connected volume.
slots.example: stacked offset concrete cube modules forming a terraced pyramidal hill
slots.ui_hint: The big shapes. Massing is what survives 3D reconstruction and voxelization — fused verbs keep the build connected.

slots.name: Materials
slots.description: Smooth plastic brick materials with named colours.
slots.example: smooth light bluish grey and tan plastic bricks
slots.ui_hint: Says 'plastic bricks' out loud — the LoRA leans in, and surfaces stay matte and buildable.

slots.name: Signature pattern
slots.description: The repeating texture or facade pattern that makes the building recognisable.
slots.example: repeating modular box pattern with recessed terrace openings
slots.ui_hint: The texture move — the one repeating detail that says 'this building' at 32 studs.

slots.name: Base & podium
slots.description: How the model meets the ground — podium, plinth, stepped base.
slots.example: cantilevered cubic clusters over a solid podium
slots.ui_hint: Grounding. A solid podium gives the voxelizer something to stand the model on.

match.pattern: podium|plinth|solid base|ground floor|monumental steps|stepped base|over a

slots.name: Named LEGO palette
slots.description: Real LEGO colour names WITH placement (which colour goes where).
slots.example: light bluish grey volumes, tan terrace insets, dark grey shadow gaps
slots.ui_hint: Named LEGO colors with placement — the color matcher maps these to real bricks.

slots.name: Studio tail
slots.description: Constant product-photography suffix; doubles as the 3D reconstruction's input conditioning.
slots.example: standalone model on dark display base, white background, elevated 3/4 angle, product photography, studio lighting, official LEGO set photography
slots.ui_hint: The studio tail — white background + 3/4 angle is exactly what the 3D reconstruction needs.

match.pattern: display base|white background|3/4 angle|product photography|studio lighting|set photography
